objective: Create an inspiring, welcoming 4:3 Careers hero illustration depicting a small diverse team collaborating around a laptop, backed by a stylized neighbourhood map with floating purple location pins, local shop/café icons, and floating milestone cards (checkmark, lightbulb, rocket) to represent community impact and mission-driven engineering.
audience: Prospective team members, engineers, designers, community managers, and talent visiting the Meelte Careers page
platform: Website Careers Page Hero Section (4:3 aspect ratio, adaptable for centered or two-column hero layout)
must_include: diverse collaborative team in Meelte flat-vector style (rounded friendly characters, 1:5.5 proportions)
modern open laptop on desk as collaboration focal point
stylized neighbourhood street map backdrop with floating purple discovery pins
small shop and café silhouette icons representing local merchant partners
floating rounded milestone cards: checkmark (trust), lightbulb (ideas), and rocket (growth)
soft circular ambient glow radiating behind the central team cluster
dominant brand pair: deep purple (#743BAA) and warm orange (#FEA711) accents
soft lavender (#F4EFFD) background for seamless blending into the Careers hero section
must_avoid: photorealism, realistic photograph, 3D render, glossy reflections, skeuomorphism
readable text, letters, fake words, typography, numbers
distorted anatomy, deformed hands, extra fingers
dark backgrounds, heavy clutter, messy wires
banned hues: cyan, teal, red, neon colors
conflict_resolution: Normalized from user draft prompts (accommodating both the primary team-collaboration concept and the safe AI-tool alternative). Corrected purple token hex from off-brand #6f3fb5 to canonical Meelte purple #743BAA. Injected required primary accent warm orange (#FEA711) into rocket, lightbulb, card highlights, and energy accents to satisfy the dominant brand pair rule (orange + purple must dominate together). Preserved requested 4:3 aspect ratio (1440x1080 target). Enforced overlay_after_generation with zero text to prevent AI lettering defects.
